answer: Every agent that wants to attest must first lock a slashable deposit into a shared oasis vault. Each epoch a randomly rotated summit of established peers audits a beacon-selected sample of new identities: the public beacon, derived from the epoch seed, names which applicants and prior attesters to inspect. If the summit finds clustered timing, cloned phrasing, or shared custody, it slashes the oasis deposit and voids those attestations. A sybil farmer must fund a distinct oasis bond per fake identity and still survive beacon-driven summit review, so attack cost scales linearly with herd size.
